title.rendered: Do Not Sell My Personal Information

content.rendered:
Do Not Sell My Personal Information

At Kiierr, we respect and value the privacy of our customers. We understand that your personal information is just that – personal. Therefore, we are committed to protecting your data and maintaining your trust.

Our Promise to You

In line with our mission to prioritize the interests and wellbeing of our customers, we uphold stringent privacy standards. We strictly adhere to the privacy laws and guidelines to ensure your information is safe and secure with us.

California Residents

If you are a resident of California, you have certain rights under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA). The CCPA provides you the right to request that we do not sell your personal information to third parties.

To make a “do not sell my personal information” request under the CCPA, please contact our customer support team at support@kiierr.com.

Processing Your Request

Upon receipt of your request, we will confirm the receipt within 10 days and provide information about how we will process the request. We are committed to responding to your request within 45 days of its receipt, in accordance with the CCPA guidelines.

Contact Us

If you have any questions or concerns about our privacy practices, please do not hesitate to contact us. Our dedicated customer support team is always here to assist you.

  • Kiierr International LLC
    Kiierr.com
  • 3500 White Way
  • Butte, Montana 59701
  • Support@kiierr.com

Your trust is vital to us, and we strive to earn it every day. At Kiierr, we believe in enhancing lives, not just through our products, but also by safeguarding the personal information you entrust to us.
